segments.text: Red light. You're first in line. Then, right in front of your bumper, the road goes: crack.
It's a sinkhole. And every time the light turns red, it gets bigger. What do you do?
Most drivers think: just go. Drive round it, quick, before it grows.
Big mistake. The traffic light sees you. And it gets angry. Red. Red! Red!
The whole crossing falls in. You drop right through the middle of the earth. And pop out in Australia. Upside down.
Here's how you do it properly.
Stay behind the line. And open the glovebox.
Your sunglasses. The green ones. Throw them onto the traffic light. Very cool.
Now every red light looks green. And with every green, the hole gets smaller.
And smaller. And smaller. Until it's just a tiny little hole.
A golf ball rolls in. Hole in one! And you drive on.
Next exam question: a total eclipse, at noon, on the motorway. Follow, so you don't miss it.
